question: Which schema limits[].kind should name a monthly byte allowance counted per account (volume-quota vs per-ip-shaping), and which should name a device-bound VPN with no published cap?
why: The corpus uses volume-quota for a per-account monthly byte allowance while the records' binding_note says per-ip-shaping is the nearest kind, and cloudflare-warp has no published limit at all; neither case fits a vocabulary kind exactly.
